exposure: maternal redemption of antibiotics during lactation
Broad-spectrum antibiotic treatment during the first two years of life
Mode of delivery (Intrapartum cesarean section, prelabor cesarean section, vaginal delivery)
maternal redemption of antibiotics during pregnancy
finding: Redemption of broad-spectrum antibiotics during infancy was associated with an increased risk of childhood type 1 diabetes in children delivered by cesarean section.
mod_finding: Broad-spectrum antibiotic use in infancy was associated with an increased rate of type 1 diabetes in children delivered by cesarean section (both intrapartum and prelabor) but not in vaginally delivered children.
